hypothesis: A TREK-1 (and TASK-1) pool closed by a lower interstitial pH is part of the Wwox Rin and rest pair
initial_observation: Rin +39 percent, rest +5.6 mV, implied E_K-like reversal (SCI43); adult TREK1-/- doubles Rin in S1 layers 2-4; TASK-1/3 double knock-out removes 26 percent of the holding current in P9-15 layer V
mechanistic_relation: extracellular acid closes both channels (recombinant pH50 7.3-7.5); closure removes a K+ conductance (INFERENZA)
context: As a PARTIAL contributor only (size check with the reported Imin 0.25: at most about a quarter to a half of the pair for a 0.2 unit difference, never the whole): requires (i) interstitial pHo at the recorded depth lower in the knock-out by 0.1-0.3 unit, (ii) a TREK-1 pool near 0.5 of the conductance, (iii) a slope of 1 or more. Whole-cell with 10 mM HEPES leaves pHo free (pHi clamped)
action: Measure, do not treat: pHo at the recording position; pHo step per cell; difference current per pF with a TASK-1 and a family-level tool at two pHo
compound_or_class: ML365 (TASK-1 over TASK-3, probe); PK-THPP (family comparator); a TREK-1 inhibitor pointer (ONO-TR-772) awaits a primary read
possible_functional_outcome: If E1 holds: the genotype difference in Rin shrinks at acid pHo (occlusion) and the pH-sensitive current per pF is larger in wild type
counter_evidence: bulk 25 mM HCO3- bath; perfused-tissue pHo moves 0.01-0.17; the TREK-1 slope in the one fit is about 0.7; TASK-3 is inert in the range; pools come from other ages and layers; a pH difference between genotypes is unmeasured
experiment_that_rejects_it: equal pHo (|difference| below 0.1) and equal pH-sensitive current per pF in the same cells
class: combined for the first time in LEGEND (Wwox pair x pH50 x native pools); acquired now: verified pH50 range, Yao and Labbaf native pools; novelty not assessed

hypothesis: A TASK-3 closure by acid explains the pair (the coda's DREAM chain)
initial_observation: TASK-3 RNA is neuron-specific at P7 (17 FPKM)
counter_evidence: TASK-3 pH50 6.3-6.5 (6.8-7.0 only in two abstracts): by the size check it closes at most 0.06-0.09 (pH50 6.3-6.5) or 0.12-0.23 (6.9, abstract level) of its own pool for a 0.2 unit fall, and that pool is part of the 0.26
experiment_that_rejects_it: pHo step in a TASK-1/3 double knock-out or a TASK-3 discriminator at two pH
class: REFUTED as quantitatively sufficient (preregistered S1 failed in detail; verified ranges); TASK-3 is not a pH sensor in this range
consumer: premise of INV-18 branch, DREAM note

hypothesis: A lactate-driven intracellular acidification acts on these channels in the recorded cell
initial_observation: 10 mM lactate lowers neuron pHi by 0.05-0.07 in perfused slices
mechanistic_relation: intracellular acid opens TREK-1; TASK pHi sensitivity unknown
context: perforated patch or cell-attached; not whole-cell with 10 mM HEPES
action: for the published values: none (pHi clamped by the pipette); for ATP-undisturbed recordings: a perforated-patch arm
counter_evidence: TREK-1 is about 0.3 percent open at pHi 7.0 (EC50 5.9): a 0.05-0.1 fall near 7.2 adds nothing; the sign would be opening, opposite to the Wwox pair
experiment_that_rejects_it: pH-sensitive current in perforated patch versus whole-cell in sibling cells
class: REFUTED for the published whole-cell values; open only as a perforated-patch control that also serves SCI44-PH4

hypothesis: A tool-by-pH interaction is the discriminating action: an occlusion test of the closed share
initial_observation: no tool was tested at more than one pH (D14)
mechanistic_relation: if a pool is already closed by acid, a blocker removes less of it at acid pH; a tool whose own potency depends on pH would mimic this
context: same cells, pHo 7.4 and 7.1, synaptic blockers, difference current per pF
action: run ML365 and PK-THPP (and a Ba2+ concentration pair) at both pHo, genotypes side by side
possible_functional_outcome: blocker effect larger in wild type than in knock-out at 7.4 and the difference vanishing at 7.1 (occlusion)
counter_evidence: the tools' own pH dependence is unmeasured; A1899 potency may depend on [K+]; PK-THPP is not selective between K2P members; ML365 untested on TREK-1 and on the heteromer
experiment_that_rejects_it: equal tool effect in both genotypes at both pH
class: new combination in LEGEND (design); acquired now: tool selectivity table

hypothesis: Metabolic change without relevant acidification acts through a K+ conductance not set by pH (KATP, or a direct lactate action on TREK1)
initial_observation: lactate closes KATP in juvenile barrel cortex (SCI44); lactate raises a TREK1 current via H328 in astrocytes at pH 7.4
context: ATP-undisturbed recording; astrocytes are wild type in the Syn-Cre model
action: SCI44 KATP arm (diazoxide, tolbutamide) on the same cells
counter_evidence: the published pipette had 2 mM ATP; the astrocytic result is abstract level
experiment_that_rejects_it: KATP tool effect per pF in perforated patch
class: known but unused (KATP, SCI44); H328 route acquired now (abstract)
